A high school freshman and an elderly woman were talking together about risk-taking, specifically focusing on risky behavior like starting fights. The high school freshman never gets into confrontations and avoids them at all costs, while the elderly woman ends up in fights pretty often, and is usually the one who started it. Who is more risk-averse?
A. Not known
B. The elderly woman
C. The high school freshman
